name: stackpicker
description: Detect the tech stack of any website

scripts.package: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('LICENSE','dist/LICENSE'); require('fs').copyFileSync('NOTICE.md','dist/NOTICE.md')" && cd dist && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Compress-Archive -Path * -DestinationPath ../stackpicker-$(node -p \"require('../package.json').version\").zip -Force"
